verdict.rationale: gstack lets users delegate substantial tasks to agent skills. A router sends any request to the right skill [gstack-docs-18], /qa iteratively fixes and commits bugs [gstack-docs-2], /ship runs the full merge-test-PR workflow [gstack-docs-3], and /autoplan chains reviews with auto-decisions [gstack-docs-5]. Community users report real speed gains [gstack-comm-1]. The assistant is not built in, though: gstack is a skill layer that runs inside an external host agent such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor [gstack-docs-13][gstack-docs-16], so a separate AI tool is required. Missing for 10: a native, self-contained assistant inside the product, and independent hands-on corroboration of delegated task outcomes beyond one anecdote.
